name: The Aeries
description: Open-air platforms enchanted with protective wards, cut into the Stronghold's upper reaches as landing and resting space for the realm's dragons. Resident Council dragons hold private alcoves here; visiting dragons alight on the broader public platforms. The views are unmatched — the entire Hollow Crown visible in every direction, from the Alpine Peaks to the Southern Lake. For a mortal visitor, the Aeries are humbling; for a dragon, they are the closest the Stronghold comes to feeling like home.
